headline: Finances, from entry to detail
overview: All-in-one financial wellbeing hub: weekly stress check-ins, money mindset beliefs, goals, values-spending alignment. Understand your relationship with money and align your finances with your values.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Finances — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the financial wellbeing dashboard with stress check-ins, mindset beliefs, and goals.

keyFeatures: Weekly financial stress check-ins to monitor your money-related anxiety
Money mindset belief exploration to uncover limiting beliefs
Financial goals tracking aligned with personal values
Values-spending alignment analysis to ensure your spending reflects what matters most
tips: Complete the weekly stress check-in consistently to spot patterns — financial stress often correlates with specific life events.
Use the values-spending alignment tool before setting budgets to ensure your financial plan reflects what truly matters to you.
